operationFailed: The operation did not complete. Please retry.
refreshedFailed: Operation completed, but the list could not refresh.
clearDescription: Permanently delete all {n} ordinary conversations, including filtered-out items. System recovery data is excluded. This cannot be undone.
noTasks: No automations yet. Create a task to get started.
filteredDetail: This task is outside the current filters
conflict: This task changed elsewhere. Some fields conflict with your edits.
missingTask: This task was deleted. Your draft is still available.
deleteTaskDescription: Deleting “{name}” stops future scheduling. Existing conversations are kept.
historicalDescription: Original files are preserved. These records are excluded from Empty trash.
historicalImportDescription: Import a conversation when you open it, or import all. Original files are kept. Other conversations remain available.
historicalSourceBusy: In use by another instance. Close it and retry.
historicalImportFailed: Import failed. Original files are preserved; retry or review recovery details.
historicalFailureWorkspaceConflict: The conversation records a different project folder than this project, so it was not imported. Original files are preserved.
historicalFailureTooLarge: The conversation history exceeds the safe replay limit and cannot be imported. Original files are preserved.
historicalFailureDamaged: The conversation history is damaged or incomplete and cannot be imported. Original files are preserved.
historicalFailureUnsupported: The conversation was written in an unsupported storage format. Original files are preserved.
historicalFailureStateConflict: The import conflicts with an already registered conversation and was stopped. Original files are preserved.
historicalFailureSourceChanged: The original conversation changed during import. Retry.
historicalOpenFailed: Imported, but the conversation could not be opened. Retry.
historicalImportToSend: Import this conversation to keep sending messages. The original file is kept.
historicalSourceUpdated: Historical source changed. Import as a separate branch.
